1743ee0456c04ef8.en: Check registration and identify both questions
1743ee0456c04ef8.zh: 核查登记并明确两个问题

3933f2bbbc1e005c.en: Prepare referral of copies to the competent authorities
3933f2bbbc1e005c.zh: 准备按职权向主管机关转交诉求副本

17f9ab8f37423281.en: Identify the competent recipient for each question
17f9ab8f37423281.zh: 确定每个问题的主管接收方

d2e5387271913b1d.en: Track the result separately for each question
d2e5387271913b1d.zh: 分别跟进每个问题的处理结果

a704736bdcb05eae.en: A written submission was received by the reception office of a Moscow executive authority. It contains two independent questions. Fictional materials without real personal data are attached. The subjects and areas of competence must be separated.
a704736bdcb05eae.zh: 莫斯科行政机关接待处收到一份书面诉求，其中包含两个独立问题。附件为不含真实个人数据的虚构材料。需要区分事项及职权范围。

d61b028f482ac0fc.en: Calculate the last day for referring copies to multiple competent authorities. This is not the date of the final reply on each question.
d61b028f482ac0fc.zh: 计算按职权向多个机关转交副本的最后期限。这不是每个问题最终答复的日期。

8fffce911a1db7d6.zh: 第 59-FZ 号联邦法律第 8 条第 4 款

c11d55e77efc6e84.en: Copies of the submission are referred to the relevant competent authorities; results are checked for each question.
c11d55e77efc6e84.zh: 诉求副本转交相应主管机关，并分别核查每个问题的结果。

be9c250988d739c8.en: Unjustified dissemination of a sensitive attachment.
be9c250988d739c8.zh: 无正当理由传播敏感附件。

4b68a089fed2ceaa.en: 1. Check the change in bus service arrangements. 2. Check the legal basis for publicly posting the applicant's telephone number and medical information.
4b68a089fed2ceaa.zh: 1. 核查公交运营安排的变化。2. 核查公开发布申请人电话和医疗信息的法律依据。

89f79b2d2f304007.en: In the training model, the transport question goes to Moscow's relevant authority, while protection of the data subject's rights goes to the authority responsible for that field. Official names and powers are checked separately.
89f79b2d2f304007.zh: 在教学模型中，交通问题转交莫斯科相关主管机关；数据主体权利保护问题转交该领域有权机关。官方名称和权限须另行核查。

81f7dfae38a2bd28.en: In real work, access to the attachment is restricted. Medical information and the telephone number are not reproduced here.
81f7dfae38a2bd28.zh: 实际工作中须限制附件访问权限。本材料不展示医疗信息和电话号码。

f0d27c74d0baa65e.en: When there are several questions, ensure that each is reviewed rather than automatically requiring new submissions.
f0d27c74d0baa65e.zh: 存在多个问题时，应确保逐一审查，而不是自动要求重新提交诉求。

752e164005529026.en: There is no submission until the citizen rewrites it as two separate letters.
752e164005529026.zh: 公民未重写成两封独立信件之前，就视为没有诉求。

a8c76661dce6050b.en: Only the transport question counts; the rest of the text is outside the submission.
a8c76661dce6050b.zh: 只有交通问题算诉求，其余文字不属于诉求内容。

51828ae3893bbd62.en: Two independent questions under different areas of competence.
51828ae3893bbd62.zh: 两个独立问题，分别属于不同职权。

3062db7b6ae154b0.en: How is the subject of the submission structured?
3062db7b6ae154b0.zh: 诉求事项由哪些部分构成？

a07caae6ddb29ecb.en: Oversight concerns each question raised, not merely the number of replies received.
a07caae6ddb29ecb.zh: 跟进针对每个已提出的问题，而不只是收到多少封信。

69a5c655f9d8d7f2.en: The transport authority replied about the bus service. Review of the personal-data question has not yet been confirmed.
69a5c655f9d8d7f2.zh: 交通机关已就公交运营作出答复，但尚未确认个人数据问题已得到审查。

50b263c196e493f3.en: Demand a new submission about personal data without checking referral of the old one.
50b263c196e493f3.zh: 不核查原诉求是否转交，就要求重新提交个人数据诉求。

5072565e21a6ee92.en: Close the entire file on receipt of the transport reply.
5072565e21a6ee92.zh: 收到交通答复后就关闭整份案卷。

76da35047a5cc86b.en: Check the second route separately; one reply does not resolve both questions.
76da35047a5cc86b.zh: 单独核查第二条处理路径；一份答复不能解决两个问题。

e516730d2de395b1.en: The first selected recipient's competence automatically covers the whole letter.
e516730d2de395b1.zh: 第一个所选接收方的职权自动涵盖整封信。

a09ac4200ea3e67b.en: The citizen must always rewrite several new submissions.
a09ac4200ea3e67b.zh: 公民始终必须重新写成多份诉求。

7cfa8a4037cdfc3a.en: Find the referral rule when a submission's questions fall within several authorities' competence.
7cfa8a4037cdfc3a.zh: 查找诉求问题分别属于多个机关职权时的转交规则。

8def38b88d81af08.en: The bus near my home now runs much less often. Also, a district institution posted my telephone number and health information on a public page. I put both issues in one letter. Do I now have to write two new ones?
8def38b88d81af08.zh: 家附近的公交车班次少了很多。另外，区里的一个机构把我的电话和健康信息放到公开网页上。我把两件事写在同一封信里。现在必须重写两封吗？

d4ddcf79322d23bc.en: My telephone number next to medical information. I attached a fictional copy separately.
d4ddcf79322d23bc.zh: 我的电话与医疗信息放在一起。我另附了一份虚构副本。

935822870379a5be.en: The second subject concerns dissemination of personal data.
935822870379a5be.zh: 第二个事项涉及个人数据传播。

8528a6406898109a.en: Yes. A reply only about the bus will not resolve the publication issue.
8528a6406898109a.zh: 需要。只答复公交问题，无法解决信息公开问题。

92d6966a80180f8e.en: The applicant asks for both questions to be reviewed.
92d6966a80180f8e.zh: 申请人要求审查两个问题。

2b4837bdad60f703.en: Do you need a result on both questions?
2b4837bdad60f703.zh: 两个问题都需要处理结果吗？

bf8d576647e1b908.en: I ask for the city bus service arrangements to be checked; this is not a dispute over a fine or tickets.
bf8d576647e1b908.zh: 我请求核查市内公交运营安排，不是罚款或车票争议。

6865aa44329648fe.en: The first subject is bus service organisation.
6865aa44329648fe.zh: 第一个事项是公交运营安排。

0448831113d222ed.en: Return the letter so the applicant must split it personally.
0448831113d222ed.zh: 退回信件，强制要求申请人自行拆分。

85ba0c8f597a43c5.en: Refer copies to the relevant competent authorities, separating the questions and necessary attachments.
85ba0c8f597a43c5.zh: 将副本转交相应主管机关，并区分问题及必要附件。

fe868e35bfd407d9.en: Send everything only to the transport authority and treat the data issue as resolved.
fe868e35bfd407d9.zh: 把全部材料仅转交交通机关，并认定数据问题已解决。

94962d98b7a13614.en: Referral requires minimising disclosure. Convenience of distribution is not an independent legal basis.
94962d98b7a13614.zh: 转交时须尽量减少信息披露。群发方便并非独立法律依据。

cddfa8c55986cee6.en: Send every attachment to every authority.
cddfa8c55986cee6.zh: 向所有机关发送全部附件。

67e9e19dfadc3c9e.en: Delete the sensitive attachment from the file without preserving it.
67e9e19dfadc3c9e.zh: 不作保存就从案卷删除敏感附件。

d48ed490bcb620f7.en: Refer attachments only to the necessary extent and within the recipient's competence.
d48ed490bcb620f7.zh: 仅在必要范围内、按接收方职权转交附件。

d4ee0d810f89c497.en: Assistant: ‘For convenience, let us attach the medical information to every outgoing letter.’
d4ee0d810f89c497.zh: 助理：“为了方便，把医疗信息附在每封发出的信里吧。”

b7fefdae0aa44826.zh: 明确诉求中的两个事项

306554f9a2f99230.en: Match the attachments to the areas of competence
306554f9a2f99230.zh: 将附件与职权范围对应

c6ad9eecd95ecbdf.en: Refer the necessary sets through the proper channels
c6ad9eecd95ecbdf.zh: 通过适当渠道转交必要材料集

3aa4505096439835.en: Limit unnecessary dissemination of private information
3aa4505096439835.zh: 限制不必要的私人信息传播

8168f7e805cce7a6.en: Set up separate oversight for both questions
8168f7e805cce7a6.zh: 分别建立两个问题的跟进安排

09312a779f792e1c.en: Publish the medical attachment in shared correspondence
09312a779f792e1c.zh: 在共享往来函件中公开医疗附件

bb984e88b3ee09d5.en: Close the second question without referring the necessary materials
bb984e88b3ee09d5.zh: 未转交必要材料就结束第二个问题的处理

1dc5172fc1972e40.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. The two questions fall under different areas of competence, both established in the training workflow. The address, route and timetable suffice for the transport question; medical information is irrelevant to it. The data question requires the relevant materials through the proper secure route. Information necessary for review is not deleted.
1dc5172fc1972e40.zh: 本案人物、文件和事件均为虚构。两个问题属于不同职权，教学流程已明确两者。交通问题只需地址、线路和时刻表，医疗信息与其无关。数据问题需要通过适当的安全渠道转交相关材料。不得删除审查所必需的信息。

ffdbdd40a4702f0e.en: Last day for referring copies under multiple areas of competence
ffdbdd40a4702f0e.zh: 按多个职权范围转交副本的最后期限

196e324516ea8b07.en: Minimisation does not mean deleting necessary evidence. Each referral's contents must match its subject.
196e324516ea8b07.zh: 最小化披露不等于删除必要证据。应核查每份转交材料的组成是否符合其事项。

c3166b48cd9b2b66.en: Article 6 of Law No. 59-FZ protects private-life information contained in a submission. Referral to an authority competent to resolve the question does not itself constitute disclosure. This does not permit sending all sensitive attachments to any recipient: the materials referred must fit the subject and powers. Necessary information must not be removed to the point that review becomes impossible.
c3166b48cd9b2b66.zh: 第 59-FZ 号法律第 6 条保护诉求中的私人生活信息。将诉求转交有权解决问题的机关，本身不构成泄露。但这并不允许向任意接收方发送所有敏感附件：转交材料必须符合事项和权限。不能过度删减必要信息，导致问题无法审查。

e01c1096ec85d7b0.en: Different subjects require different relevant sets, not the same complete archive for everyone. Minimisation does not mean deleting necessary evidence. Each referral's contents must match its subject.
e01c1096ec85d7b0.zh: 不同事项需要不同的相关材料集，而不是向所有人发送同一份完整档案。最小化披露不等于删除必要证据。应核查每份转交材料的组成是否符合其事项。

6d4c4914b5dcb18a.en: Different subjects require different relevant sets, not the same complete archive for everyone.
6d4c4914b5dcb18a.zh: 不同事项需要不同的相关材料集，而不是向所有人发送同一份完整档案。

22146b767108bbc1.en: Every handler always needs the entire archive regardless of powers.
22146b767108bbc1.zh: 不论权限如何，每个承办人始终都需要完整档案。

15829b7db247606d.en: Data protection requires deleting all evidence concerning the second question.
15829b7db247606d.zh: 保护数据就必须删除第二个问题的全部证据。

3923394d47519d4c.en: Ensure the necessary materials reach the second recipient and continue separate oversight. Minimisation does not mean deleting necessary evidence. Each referral's contents must match its subject.
3923394d47519d4c.zh: 确保必要材料送达第二个接收方，并继续单独跟进。最小化披露不等于删除必要证据。应核查每份转交材料的组成是否符合其事项。

9be6c2f0ab8f6d0e.en: The transport reply has arrived. The second recipient says the necessary attachment was never sent to them.
9be6c2f0ab8f6d0e.zh: 已收到交通部门答复。第二个接收方表示，所需附件根本没有转给他们。

d5a3d1c4a62c37cf.en: Ensure the necessary materials reach the second recipient and continue separate oversight.
d5a3d1c4a62c37cf.zh: 确保必要材料送达第二个接收方，并继续单独跟进。

d657612b428abb11.en: Treat all the material as completed on the basis of the transport reply.
d657612b428abb11.zh: 凭交通部门答复认定全部事项已办结。

8f8a3b3446b0aae0.en: Send the complete archive to every department just in case.
8f8a3b3446b0aae0.zh: 以防万一，把完整档案发给所有部门。

b1abc77adcb949d9.en: Remove the second question from the reply to reduce the document set.
b1abc77adcb949d9.zh: 为缩减材料集，从答复中删除第二个问题。

17accfc9d22df1c6.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Prepare relevant sets for each competent recipient and retain oversight of both questions.
17accfc9d22df1c6.zh: 查找以下行动的法律依据：为每个主管接收方准备相关材料集，并继续跟进两个问题。

cc396530ef34aba3.en: In one letter I wrote about the bus route and publication of my child's medical data. The whole letter, including the medical attachments, was sent to the transport authority.
cc396530ef34aba3.zh: 我在一封信里写了公交线路问题，以及孩子医疗数据被公开的问题。整封信连同医疗附件都发给了交通部门。

99f48b7b7c069fea.en: Question 1: a missing stop on route M-4. Attachment A: route diagram. Question 2: dissemination of a child's medical information. Attachment B: supporting material containing sensitive data.
99f48b7b7c069fea.zh: 问题 1：M-4 线路缺少停靠站。附件 A：线路图。问题 2：儿童医疗信息被传播。附件 B：含敏感数据的证明材料。

24ef0d217babcba8.en: The transport unit reviews question 1 using attachment A. Question 2 goes to the appropriately competent authority with the necessary materials; the transport unit does not need attachment B.
24ef0d217babcba8.zh: 交通部门依据附件 A 审查问题 1。问题 2 连同必要材料转交相应主管机关；交通部门不需要附件 B。

b6d0bafc8fb54476.en: One complete archive containing both attachments has been prepared for every recipient without differentiating the contents.
b6d0bafc8fb54476.zh: 为所有接收方准备了同一份包含两个附件的完整档案，未区分内容。

0bd279c8b66ff92b.en: You prepare a decision and actions within the stated role. Competence is established by the materials. You do not prescribe treatment, impose real sanctions or send real submissions. The two questions fall under different areas of competence, both established in the training workflow. The address, route and timetable suffice for the transport question; medical information is irrelevant to it. The data question requires the relevant materials through the proper secure route. Information necessary for review is not deleted.
0bd279c8b66ff92b.zh: 你在规定角色范围内准备决定和行动。材料已确定职权条件。你不安排治疗、不实施真实制裁，也不发送真实诉求。两个问题属于不同职权，教学流程已明确两者。交通问题只需地址、线路和时刻表，医疗信息与其无关。数据问题需要通过适当的安全渠道转交相关材料。不得删除审查所必需的信息。

11670a8a13b1e4fe.en: Prepare relevant sets for each competent recipient and retain oversight of both questions.
11670a8a13b1e4fe.zh: 为每个主管接收方准备相关材料集，并继续跟进两个问题。

a785f09b7eb776fc.en: Prepare relevant sets for each competent recipient and retain oversight of both questions. Minimisation does not mean deleting necessary evidence. Each referral's contents must match its subject.
a785f09b7eb776fc.zh: 为每个主管接收方准备相关材料集，并继续跟进两个问题。最小化披露不等于删除必要证据。应核查每份转交材料的组成是否符合其事项。

3bf47702cf196769.en: Send sensitive material to the transport unit without need.
3bf47702cf196769.zh: 无必要地向交通部门发送敏感材料。

7e6f9ec2da628d47.en: Compare each question with the materials received
7e6f9ec2da628d47.zh: 将每个问题与收到的材料对照

695ad83d853d9d4f.en: Preserve the confirmed result for the first question
695ad83d853d9d4f.zh: 保留第一个问题已确认的结果

cf2b7d13020c7eca.en: Restore oversight of the unreviewed part
cf2b7d13020c7eca.zh: 恢复对未审查部分的跟进

08628fb57f40d899.en: Tell the citizen the actual status without falsely closing the case
08628fb57f40d899.zh: 如实告知公民处理状态，不虚假结案

d380e97b06f52d1b.en: Check the relevant reply about lighting and the original deadline
d380e97b06f52d1b.zh: 核查照明问题的相关答复及原始期限

c9b708a0d7f52555.en: Close the second question using an irrelevant record
c9b708a0d7f52555.zh: 用不相关记录结束第二个问题的处理

3268da1e0ff462e6.en: Delete the original date to obtain a new deadline
3268da1e0ff462e6.zh: 为取得新期限而删除原始日期

1ff9acdb0f053bf4.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. Both questions are separately raised in the accepted submission and fall within established areas of competence. The record confirms only pothole repair; it mentions neither lighting nor a check of it. No extension was arranged for the unreviewed part. The citizen's supplementary letter points out the omission without cancelling the original registration.
1ff9acdb0f053bf4.zh: 本案人物、文件和事件均为虚构。已受理诉求分别提出两个问题，且均属于已确定职权。记录仅确认修补坑洞，未提及照明及其检查。未审查部分没有办理延期。公民补充来信指出遗漏，不会撤销原始登记。

8aea77143887cd39.en: This is a completeness check, not a new complaint about a pothole already repaired. Combining questions in one letter does not make them one action.
8aea77143887cd39.zh: 这是完整性核查，不是对已修好坑洞的新投诉。多个问题写在同一封信里，并不会变成同一项行动。

42c147d343ada86d.en: The first subject is resolved; the second result is unconfirmed and oversight has been lost. This is a completeness check, not a new complaint about a pothole already repaired. Combining questions in one letter does not make them one action.
42c147d343ada86d.zh: 第一个事项已解决；第二个事项结果未确认，且失去了跟进。这是完整性核查，不是对已修好坑洞的新投诉。多个问题写在同一封信里，并不会变成同一项行动。

64c1d19bd424a67d.en: The first subject is resolved; the second result is unconfirmed and oversight has been lost.
64c1d19bd424a67d.zh: 第一个事项已解决；第二个事项结果未确认，且失去了跟进。

c27d9b6b3a0a48e4.en: Any result concerning the letter permits closure of the entire submission.
c27d9b6b3a0a48e4.zh: 信件只要有任何结果，就可以将整份诉求结案。

cc35a3fd44ec1aeb.en: Every reminder from the citizen automatically restarts the deadline.
cc35a3fd44ec1aeb.zh: 公民每次提醒都会自动重新起算期限。

68abe4475e329f09.en: Check the result at the specified location without counting a neighbouring streetlight. This is a completeness check, not a new complaint about a pothole already repaired. Combining questions in one letter does not make them one action.
68abe4475e329f09.zh: 核查指定地点的结果，不把邻近路灯算作本事项完成。这是完整性核查，不是对已修好坑洞的新投诉。多个问题写在同一封信里，并不会变成同一项行动。

0ee899ab14888135.en: The responsible person sent a statement about a streetlight in the neighbouring courtyard. It does not identify the approach described in the submission.
0ee899ab14888135.zh: 负责人发来邻近庭院路灯的证明，其中未注明诉求所指的通行路段。

e32cfe0838756b62.en: Check the result at the specified location without counting a neighbouring streetlight.
e32cfe0838756b62.zh: 核查指定地点的结果，不把邻近路灯算作本事项完成。

d5da2bc8169f8eb9.en: Close the question based on any functioning streetlight.
d5da2bc8169f8eb9.zh: 凭任何一盏正常路灯就结案。

b16f4386d7b5ad86.en: Ask the citizen to submit all documents from scratch.
b16f4386d7b5ad86.zh: 请公民从头提交全部文件。

eb23b23c6ef43289.en: Restart the general deadline because of the reminder.
eb23b23c6ef43289.zh: 因收到提醒而重新起算一般期限。

95aee4fa463bc394.en: Send the same pothole record as the reply about lighting.
95aee4fa463bc394.zh: 把同一份坑洞维修记录作为照明问题的答复。

f693a8deb730cae7.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Continue reviewing the omitted part in its original context and check the completeness of the final reply.
f693a8deb730cae7.zh: 查找以下行动的法律依据：在原始背景下继续审查遗漏部分，并核查最终答复的完整性。

25ed68ea388c0a0c.en: I wrote about a pothole and faulty lighting. They filled the pothole but said nothing about the lights. The system says ‘everything completed’.
25ed68ea388c0a0c.zh: 我写了坑洞和照明故障的问题。坑补好了，灯却没提。系统显示“全部完成”。

7b3c06868c20f0e9.en: Two independent questions: a pothole near the building and lack of lighting on the approach. Both contain sufficient descriptions of their locations.
7b3c06868c20f0e9.zh: 两个独立问题：楼旁坑洞，以及通行路段缺乏照明。两者都有充分的地点描述。

754c453f396a9abe.en: The record concerns filling the pothole. The reply describes only road repairs and contains no lighting information.
754c453f396a9abe.zh: 记录针对坑洞修补。答复仅描述道路维修，没有照明信息。

dea7b019471a1075.en: The entire submission's status was changed to ‘completed’ after one record. The lighting assignment remains unanswered.
dea7b019471a1075.zh: 收到一份记录后，整份诉求状态被改为“已完成”。照明任务仍未得到答复。

c28c33ce7c3ddde8.en: You prepare a decision and actions within the stated role. Competence is established by the materials. You do not prescribe treatment, impose real sanctions or send real submissions. Both questions are separately raised in the accepted submission and fall within established areas of competence. The record confirms only pothole repair; it mentions neither lighting nor a check of it. No extension was arranged for the unreviewed part. The citizen's supplementary letter points out the omission without cancelling the original registration.
c28c33ce7c3ddde8.zh: 你在规定角色范围内准备决定和行动。材料已确定职权条件。你不安排治疗、不实施真实制裁，也不发送真实诉求。已受理诉求分别提出两个问题，且均属于已确定职权。记录仅确认修补坑洞，未提及照明及其检查。未审查部分没有办理延期。公民补充来信指出遗漏，不会撤销原始登记。

6dfa825206c90303.en: Continue reviewing the omitted part in its original context and check the completeness of the final reply.
6dfa825206c90303.zh: 在原始背景下继续审查遗漏部分，并核查最终答复的完整性。

251c6c45230ad2c2.en: A reply to the first question is not a reply to the whole letter
251c6c45230ad2c2.zh: 答复第一个问题，不等于答复整封信

a059b6d8e51172bf.en: Continue reviewing the omitted part in its original context and check the completeness of the final reply. This is a completeness check, not a new complaint about a pothole already repaired. Combining questions in one letter does not make them one action.
a059b6d8e51172bf.zh: 在原始背景下继续审查遗漏部分，并核查最终答复的完整性。这是完整性核查，不是对已修好坑洞的新投诉。多个问题写在同一封信里，并不会变成同一项行动。

d7b0c27603506374.en: A pothole repair record does not confirm review of the lighting question.
d7b0c27603506374.zh: 坑洞维修记录不能证明已审查照明问题。

55a15013800e7c90.en: Identify both subjects and the official being complained about
55a15013800e7c90.zh: 确定两个事项及被投诉人员

2dd20becbb9a14ae.zh: 指定适当且分开的处理路径

a0e3540cc5f7f036.en: Obtain the necessary materials and explanations without self-review
a0e3540cc5f7f036.zh: 获取必要材料和说明，不让被投诉者自审

ce5c56b4720305fa.en: Keep the citizen informed about both routes
ce5c56b4720305fa.zh: 持续向公民告知两个方向的处理情况

47e41627ab44ef17.en: Check both the repair outcome and the independent complaint decision
47e41627ab44ef17.zh: 同时核查维修结果与对投诉作出的独立决定

27912f1fab9a50c6.en: Prejudge guilt solely from the applicant's account
27912f1fab9a50c6.zh: 仅凭申请人的说法预先认定责任

4dcc555b6415e709.en: Close the complaint with the signature of the very person complained about
4dcc555b6415e709.zh: 凭被投诉者本人的签字将投诉结案

1a61356317995494.en: All people, documents and events in this case are fictional. The general submissions procedure applies, not a special procedural appeal. One document contains a repair request and a complaint about specific official I-7's actions. The proper independent complaint route is given. The technical contractor may receive the relevant work request; final review of the complaint is not assigned to I-7.
1a61356317995494.zh: 本案人物、文件和事件均为虚构。适用一般诉求程序，而非特殊程序性申诉。同一文件包含维修请求，以及对具体公职人员 I-7 行为的投诉。已给出适当的独立投诉处理路径。技术作业承办方可以接收相关报修，但不能把投诉的最终审查交给 I-7。

9eba9e46d7f9343c.en: A shared site does not make a technical request and a complaint about an official the same subject.
9eba9e46d7f9343c.zh: 对象相同，不会使技术报修与对公职人员的投诉变成同一事项。

f298ba545d18e25e.en: Separate technical performance from independent review of the complaint about previous actions. A shared site does not make a technical request and a complaint about an official the same subject.
f298ba545d18e25e.zh: 需要区分技术履行与对先前行为投诉的独立审查。对象相同，不会使技术报修与对公职人员的投诉变成同一事项。

f49d668dfdd435ec.en: Separate technical performance from independent review of the complaint about previous actions.
f49d668dfdd435ec.zh: 需要区分技术履行与对先前行为投诉的独立审查。

1aa9eefd51cef7a7.en: Repair automatically removes the need to review a complaint about the reply.
1aa9eefd51cef7a7.zh: 维修会自动消除审查针对答复之投诉的必要。

98fba9b3607dccc4.en: The person complained about cannot even be asked to provide an explanation.
98fba9b3607dccc4.zh: 甚至不能请被投诉者提供说明。

29097f10313429e5.en: Preserve the repair as a confirmed result and continue proper review of the complaint. A shared site does not make a technical request and a complaint about an official the same subject.
29097f10313429e5.zh: 保留维修这一已确认结果，并继续适当审查投诉。对象相同，不会使技术报修与对公职人员的投诉变成同一事项。

b4b6f2410996f6ff.en: The path has been restored. There is no decision about the previous reply, but the entire document has been closed.
b4b6f2410996f6ff.zh: 小路已修复。尚无对先前答复的处理决定，但整份文件已结案。

e4a28ff1e1311560.en: Preserve the repair as a confirmed result and continue proper review of the complaint.
e4a28ff1e1311560.zh: 保留维修这一已确认结果，并继续适当审查投诉。

e8920a1f90946e49.en: Treat the repair as a reply to every argument about previous actions.
e8920a1f90946e49.zh: 将维修视为对先前行为所有质疑的答复。

ebda29c2b684c66a.en: Undo the completed repair for the sake of the review.
ebda29c2b684c66a.zh: 为开展核查而撤销已完成的维修。

9da15536a3ada879.en: Ignore the repair until the entire reply review is finished.
9da15536a3ada879.zh: 在答复核查全部结束前，不理会维修问题。

edf2d421506b8d19.en: Find the legal basis for the following action: Organise the repair route separately from proper complaint review, requesting the relevant materials.
edf2d421506b8d19.zh: 查找以下行动的法律依据：分别组织维修路径和适当的投诉审查，并调取相关材料。

1acc11f1df96029b.en: I need the path restored and an investigation into why the inspector reported completion when no work had been done. They assigned the whole letter to him again.
1acc11f1df96029b.zh: 我需要修复小路，也需要核查为什么明明没有施工，检查员却报告已完成。他们又把整封信交给他处理。

37b52b05610d610c.en: Question A: a damaged path. Question B: the accuracy of official I-7's previous reply stating that work was complete.
37b52b05610d610c.zh: 问题 A：小路损坏。问题 B：公职人员 I-7 此前声称工作已完成的答复是否真实。

eaa1a44273306322.en: I-7 reported completion. Dated materials show that the site had not been restored by the specified date; the final causes and responsibility have not yet been established.
eaa1a44273306322.zh: I-7 报告已完成。带日期材料显示，到所指日期现场尚未修复；最终原因和责任尚未确定。

dac915dbf425c717.en: Both questions were referred entirely to I-7 for his own final reply. No independent complaint review was assigned.
dac915dbf425c717.zh: 两个问题全部交给 I-7，由其自行作出最终答复。未安排独立投诉核查。
